node.wrapper:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

cd /work
if [ ! -d node_modules ]; then
    cp -R /opt/dependencies/node_modules node_modules
fi
export PATH="/work/node_modules/.bin:${PATH}"

run_task() {
    task=$1
    shift
    case "$task" in
    lint)
        : CHECK_LINT
        ;;
    test)
        : CHECK_TEST
        ;;
    build)
        : CHECK_BUILD
        ;;
    *)
        printf 'Unknown check task: %s\n' "$task" >&2
        exit 2
        ;;
    esac
}

case "${1:-}" in
check)
    for task in ${CHECK_TASKS:?CHECK_TASKS is required}; do
        run_task "$task"
    done
    ;;
lint|test|build)
    task=$1
    shift
    run_task "$task" "$@"
    ;;
exec)
    shift
    if [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; then
        exec "$@"
    fi
    : "${COMMAND:?COMMAND is required}"
    exec sh -ec "$COMMAND"
    ;;
*)
    printf 'Usage: check check|lint|test|build|exec\n' >&2
    exit 2
    ;;
esac

go.wrapper:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

mkdir -p /scratch/go-mod /scratch/go-cache /scratch/go /scratch/home
if [ ! -f /scratch/go-mod-ready ]; then
    cp -a /opt/go-mod/. /scratch/go-mod/
    touch /scratch/go-mod-ready
fi
export GOPATH=/scratch/go GOCACHE=/scratch/go-cache GOMODCACHE=/scratch/go-mod
export GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off
export GOLANGCI_LINT_CACHE=/scratch/golangci-lint

command=$1
shift
case "$command" in
    check)
        : CHECK_CHECK
        ;;
    exec)
        : CHECK_EXEC
        ;;
    lint)
        : CHECK_LINT
        ;;
    test)
        : CHECK_TEST
        ;;
    build)
        : CHECK_BUILD
        ;;
    *)
        : CHECK_*
        ;;
esac
go.lint:
shellcheck -x -P SCRIPTDIR tests/container/run tests/container/check
        unset GOPROXY GOSUMDB
        git config --global --add safe.directory /work
        git init --quiet --initial-branch=main .
        git add --all
        git -c user.name='Container checks' -c user.email=checks@example.invalid \
            commit --quiet -m 'Check source snapshot'
        git remote add origin REPOSITORY
        go mod verify
        go mod tidy -diff
        golangci-lint config verify
        golangci-lint run
        go tool govulncheck ./...
        goreleaser check
        markdownlint-cli2

        ;;

        ;;
    lint)

        ;;
    test)
        : CHECK_TEST
        ;;
    build)
        : CHECK_BUILD
        ;;
    *)

        ;;

rust.lint:
shellcheck -x -P SCRIPTDIR tests/container/run tests/container/check scripts/test-in-container .cargo-husky/hooks/pre-commit

python-direct: RUN test "$(python -c 'import sys; print(f"{sys.version_info.major}.{sys.version_info.minor}")')" = "$(cat /opt/check/.python-version)"      && python -m venv /opt/check/venv      && /opt/check/venv/bin/python -m pip install --no-cache-dir --disable-pip-version-check          -r /opt/check/requirements-dev.txt
python-poetry: RUN python -m venv /opt/venv      && python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check poetry==2.5.1
rust: RUN apt-get update && apt-get install --no-install-recommends --yes git ca-certificates
RUN rustup component add clippy rustfmt      && rustup target add aarch64-apple-darwin
RUN mkdir src && printf 'fn main() {}\n' > src/main.rs      && cargo fetch --locked      && chmod -R a+rX /usr/local/cargo/registry
art-kit: RUN node --input-type=module -e 'import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs"; const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync("/opt/package.json", "utf8")); writeFileSync("package.json", JSON.stringify({ private: true, dependencies: { ...p.devDependencies, ...p.peerDependencies } }));'      && npm install --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund      && cd node_modules/skia-canvas      && node lib/prebuild.mjs download
game-kit: RUN mkdir /tmp/dependencies && cp /opt/check/package*.json /tmp/dependencies/ &&      cd /tmp/dependencies && npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund

game-dev.helper:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

category=${1:-check}
if [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; then shift; fi
case "${category}" in
    check)
        for category in ${CHECK_TASKS}; do /opt/check/run "${category}"; done
        ;;
    lint)
        shellcheck -x -P SCRIPTDIR tests/container/run tests/container/check tests/container/staged tests/container/staged-git
        markdownlint-cli2 "$@"
        ;;
    exec)
        if [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; then exec "$@"; fi
        exec sh -ec "${COMMAND:?COMMAND is required}"
        ;;
    *)
        printf 'Unknown check category: %s\n' "${category}" >&2
        exit 2
        ;;
esac

        shellcheck -x -P SCRIPTDIR \
            tests/container/run tests/container/check \
            scripts/check.sh scripts/pack.sh scripts/provision.sh

esac

exec node /work/tests/container/check.mts "$@"
